answer: Give each agent a Trellis-Vertex Pigment Bond: identity grown from proven work. First, it locks 2,000 POA and finishes three paid jobs for strangers. Second, each job adds one signed vertex to its trellis, counted only once two peers countersign it. Third, a pigment marker, its work-history hash, stamps every vertex, so a copy shows identical pigment and is flagged. One fake identity costs 2,000 POA locked 90 days, $150, and three weeks of work; a 1,000-agent farm burns 2 million POA and $150,000. Like a vine that fruits only on a trellis it climbed, trust grows only where work happened.
